notes: Jacobsen possessory-interference test at the decision; No-branch = Karo (no then-existing possessory interest -> not a seizure, later search question may remain); Yes = Soldal (seizure even if nothing searched); then separate reasonableness split: brief detention + diligent warrant effort -> reasonable on RS (Van Leeuwen) vs prolonged ~90min/destruction -> needs PC (Place; Jacobsen field test). Every node matches page rule. Clean layout.

Two-roads faithful: force + intent to restrain (Brower means-intentionally-applied) -> SEIZED at moment force applied, submission irrelevant (Torres); show of authority (Mendenhall free-to-leave) -> SUBMIT? No/fleeing -> not seized (Hodari D.), Yes -> seized (Hodari D.); neither/mere presence-pursuit -> consensual, not a seizure (Chesternut). Actual seizures feed reasonableness tail: consensual none / Terry RS / arrest PC (Royer, Dunaway, Atwater). Non-seizure nodes correctly do NOT proceed to reasonableness. Legible.

Escalation ladder matches page: consensual encounter <-> Step 1 Terry stop (RAS crime afoot) via 'facts rise to RAS' / 'suspicion dispelled'; Step 1 -> Step 2 protective frisk on SEPARATE RAS armed & dangerous; Step 1 -> arrest on over-long/over-intrusive/transport/facts-rise-to-PC; Step 2 -> arrest on facts rise to PC. Bold Step labels and & entity render correctly. Legible.

Objective-violation gate (RAS or PC; pretext irrelevant Whren/Sullivan; reasonable mistake of law Heien; common-sense inference Glover): No -> unlawful, no random/standardless stops (Prouse); Yes -> lawful stop, work the MISSION (Rodriguez). Control&safety node: order occupants out no-suspicion Mimms/Wilson, passengers seized Brendlin, person frisk on RAS armed&dangerous Johnson, compartment frisk on RAS of weapon Long/Vinton. Prolong for unrelated investigation (dog sniff not a search Caballes): adds time no independent RAS -> UNLAWFUL mission exceeded (Rodriguez) vs no added time/independent RAS -> permissible. All 11 diagram cases verified present at matching page nodes (Vinton at page lines 40/60/87). Legible.

Make arrest -> PC for SOME offense? No -> unlawful (no PC); Yes (objective; motive/label irrelevant, Devenpeck) -> Where? Public place -> no warrant needed even fine-only offense / even if state law barred it (Watson, Atwater, Moore); inside a home -> warrant or exigency (cross-ref Entry to Arrest, consistent with Payton line). Public branch -> prompt judicial PC check if warrantless (Gerstein back-end). Faithful, legible.

Whose home/what authority? Suspect's OWN home -> arrest warrant + reason to believe within (Payton, Kirk); THIRD party's home -> homeowner needs SEARCH warrant (Steagald) + overnight guest's own REP (Olson); no warrant -> consent (lawful entry) or exigency/pursuit -> gate it (Santana/Lange/Welsh/King). Payton branch -> Payton violation suppresses in-home fruits but OUTSIDE statement OK if PC (New York v. Harris). Every branch matches page rule. Legible.

Warrantless arrest on PC -> booking/administrative steps (Gerstein) -> judicial PC determination within 48h? Yes & not unreasonably delayed -> presumptively prompt (McLaughlin); within 48h but unreasonably delayed -> may still violate Gerstein (arrestee's burden); No, past 48h -> government must show bona fide emergency, weekends do not count. Matches McLaughlin burden-shift exactly. Legible.

Known facts -> fair-probability-on-totality gate (Gates, Brinegar): mere possibility/bare suspicion -> no PC (no arrest/full search/warrant); fair probability -> PC. PC fans to: objective, judged on facts known not charge named (Devenpeck); whole picture, no divide-and-conquer (Wesby, Arvizu); authorizes arrest/full search/warrant -> warrant (neutral magistrate, deferential review Ventresca) vs warrantless (government justifies under an exception Coolidge). Faithful. Cosmetic: PC->Objective edge routes leftward under the No node, still legible.

Specific articulable facts + rational inferences -> particularized & objective basis on whole picture (Terry, Cortez): bare hunch/generic tip -> NOT RS, no stop/frisk (Terry, Florida v. J.L.); innocent facts combine -> RS (more than hunch, less than PC). RS -> brief investigative stop AND frisk gate (reasonable fear armed & dangerous? yes -> protective frisk of outer clothing, no -> stop only). Stop -> facts climb to fair probability? yes -> PC (arrest/full search/warrant), no -> investigate briefly then release. Faithful, legible.

Content faithful. Whose 4A right invaded (rights personal: no vicarious/target/coconspirator standing, Rakas/Alderman/Padilla/Payner): someone else's -> no standing; maybe mine -> legitimate REP in the PLACE/thing (Katz/Rakas): owner of ITEM only no place-REP -> no standing (Rawlings); overnight guest -> standing (Olson); short-term commercial visitor -> no (Carter); shared workplace -> standing (Mancusi); lawful rental driver -> standing (Byrd). Separate: passenger in stopped car (Brendlin) seized by the STOP, may challenge the stop (not automatically the car search). COSMETIC ONLY: dense edge labels cause the 'Rawlings' and 'Mancusi' tokens to partially underlap adjacent labels (Carter / Byrd); layout crowding per B-MER precedent, not a harness or faithfulness defect; .mmd source correct.

Fruit of a 4A violation (Silverthorne, Wong Sun) -> come at by EXPLOITATION of illegality? (Wong Sun): No/sufficiently distinguishable -> admitted, taint purged; Yes -> escape hatch? Attenuation (Brown factors: time, intervening cause, flagrancy; warrant found Strieff; witness Ceccolini) / independent source · inevitable discovery / good faith -> admitted; none applies -> suppress from case-in-chief (still impeach the defendant himself, Walder/Havens/James). Faithful. Cosmetic: three hatch edge labels crowd near the ADMITTED convergence, all readable.

Evidence found after an illegality -> also obtained through a lawful source genuinely independent, not prompted by it? (Murray): Yes -> admitted, independent source; No -> would it inevitably have been found by lawful means (preponderance)? (Nix): yes real route -> admitted, inevitable discovery; only speculative -> suppress (Neugin). Faithful, legible.

Search under warrant/statute/record later found INVALID -> objectively reasonable reliance? (Leon): No -> suppress (culpable conduct to deter); Yes -> any of Leon's four floors? [false affidavit Franks; non-neutral magistrate Lo-Ji; bare-bones affidavit; facially deficient warrant Groh] -> suppress; none -> admitted, nothing to deter (Sheppard/Krull/Evans/Davis). Separate wrong-forum node (grand jury/civil tax/deportation/parole) -> rule does not apply (Calandra/Janis/Lopez-Mendoza/Scott). Every case at correct node. Legible.

Evidence via 4A violation (+ fruits) -> Standing? (own REP): No -> admitted, no suppression; Yes -> does an exception break the chain? attenuation/fruits limit / independent source or inevitable discovery / good faith / wrong forum or cost>benefit -> admitted; none applies -> suppress case-in-chief evidence + fruits (still impeach the defendant). Mirrors page's standing-gate -> fruit reach -> escape hatches -> cost-benefit boundaries sequence. Cosmetic: four exception edge labels crowd at the ADMITTED convergence, all readable.
